description: Good games, good food and good vibes!
summary: We developed a fun little game for children, that lets them play as an astronaut on moon base. They learn to manage resources for different space missions. This teaches them to prioritize certain requirements even it comes to limited resources in a space environment.
details: We used Typescript and Vite, and coded the game on vs code. The game design is pixelated as they are more engaging and attractive to children. This teaches them to manage limited resources as an astronaut in moon base.
